Latin word

experior

experior, experīrī, expertus sum

verb, fourth conjugation, deponent

try; in the perfect, know from experience; try, test, put to the proof; experience

In this lexicon

  • experience

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 13.9.3: illud tibi expertus prōmittō et spondeō; Cic. Planc. 22: dīcō expertus in nōbīs (Lewis & Short)

  • experiment

    also used · classical · Cic. Cael. 58: vim ejus esse expertum in servō (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • illud tibi expertus prōmittō et spondeō

    this I promise and guarantee you from my own experienceCic. Fam. 13.9.3
